tasks.details: 2026-10-04 FINDING (John's Drive upload): the 'OKF server software' is byte-identical to Helix's own src/okf/ module — there is no standalone server. KEY INSIGHT: Helix was designed to BE its own OKF server: src/io/web_server/mod.rs already mounts /okf/status, /okf/registry, /okf/health, /okf/schema, POST /okf/webhook (public) and POST /okf/reload, /okf/reload/force, /okf/manifest (protected), gated on [helix.okf] enabled (default false). BUT Helix's own fetcher (src/okf/fetcher.rs) requests endpoints the server does NOT mount: GET /okf/manifest.json, GET /okf/bundles/{id}/manifest.json, GET /okf/knowledge/{kid}. So Helix cannot serve itself — the server half and client half disagree on paths. The v1 protocol MUST reconcile the mounted routes with what the fetcher (and grok-cli) expect; do not design in a vacuum. GROUND TRUTH (verified 2026-10-04 against actual code): the two OKF clients were built against different imagined servers. Helix (src/okf/fetcher.rs) expects: GET {base}/okf/manifest.json, GET {base}/okf/bundles/{id}/manifest.json, GET {base}/okf/knowledge/{kid}, GET {base}/okf/health, optional Bearer auth_token, ETag/If-None-Match. grok-cli expects: POST {http(s)}://{server}:{port}/api/traces (default port 8080, 10s timeout, buffer-on-failure; src/workflow/okf.rs), POST {remote_url}/bundles/{bundle}/concepts (15s timeout; src/tools/okf_tools.rs push_concept_to_remote). grok-cli has NO remote fetch; Helix has NO push/trace. No single server satisfies both. CANONICAL v1 PROPOSAL (minimizes churn — Helix reads stay as-is): GET /okf/health -> 200 {"status":"ok"}; GET /okf/manifest.json and GET /okf/bundles/{id}/manifest.json -> manifest matching okf_bundle_schema.json (required: id, version); GET /okf/knowledge/{kid} -> document; POST /okf/traces (JSON WorkflowTrace, was grok-cli /api/traces); POST /okf/bundles/{bundle}/concepts (JSON OkfConcept, was grok-cli /bundles/{b}/concepts). Optional Bearer auth on all; ETag/If-None-Match on GETs; JSON error bodies {"error": ...}. WORK: write PROTOCOL.md (repo root or src/okf/) documenting every endpoint with request/response examples; update any Helix paths that deviate; grok-cli retarget is task grok-cli#480 (cross-repo — coordinate, do not duplicate). Contract tests: mock HTTP server asserting exact paths, methods, auth headers, ETag round-trip, and shape conformance to okf_bundle_schema.json.
